tagline: International shipping company specializing in eco-efficient tanker operations
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is key because it directly reflects operational efficiency and demand for eco-efficient vessels, a central driver in decarbonized maritime transport. This ratio captures the operational performance that creates value in this business model.

kpis.name: Fleet Utilization Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of time ships are used to transport cargo
kpis.description: Utilization rate remained high at 97% in 2024, down 1 point from 2023 (98%), reflecting strong demand but a slight operational slowdown.
kpis.signal: Very high utilization rate despite slight decline

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from crude oil transportation
kpis.description: Revenue reached $393 million in 2024, down 5% from 2023 ($413 million), following a +52% growth the previous year.

kpis.name: Cargo Carried
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of crude oil transported in metric tons
kpis.description: 20.8 million tons carried in 2024, compared to 23.4 million in 2023, a 11.1% decrease, likely linked to reduced operating days.

kpis.name: Operating and Management Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to vessel operations and fleet management
kpis.description: Operating and management expenses reached over $47 million in 2024, slightly up from over $46 million in 2023.

kpis.name: Scope 2 Emissions Reduction
kpis.explanation: Reduction in indirect electricity and energy emissions
kpis.description: The company reduced its Scope 2 emissions by 35% in 2024, thanks to more efficient energy use in offices and during dry-dockings.

kpis.name: Salaries and Benefits
kpis.explanation: Total cost of salaries and benefits for direct employees
kpis.description: Salaries and benefits reached $7.7 million in 2024, a significant increase from $5.8 million in 2023.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €1.2 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.61 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Female Presence in Seafarers
kpis.explanation: Increase in women's representation among crew members
kpis.description: The share of women in seafaring crews increased to 15% in 2024, up from 11% in 2023, marking progress in diversity.

kpis.name: Payments to Capital Providers
kpis.explanation: Total dividends, interest, and share buybacks paid
kpis.description: Payments to capital providers decreased to $160 million in 2024, from $219 million in 2023, reflecting a more prudent cash policy.

risks.title: Cyclical volatility of oil tanker freight rates
risks.summary: Oil tanker freight rates (measured by the BDTI index) fluctuate significantly based on vessel supply/demand and global oil demand. These unpredictable variations directly affect revenues and profitability of charter contracts. For example, the BDTI ranged from 799 to 1468 in 2025, creating major uncertainty around future revenues.
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in the industry section with highly intensive language ("cyclical and volatile", "material adverse effect"). Multiple references to BDTI indices and extreme historical fluctuations (799-1468 in 2025). Trend stable but amplified by geopolitics. Categorically major weight for an oil tanker operator.

risks.title: Dependence on oil demand and energy transition
risks.summary: The global energy transition is structurally reducing oil demand: 25% of new cars sold in 2025 are electric (vs 18% in 2024), and the IEA forecasts a peak in oil demand around 2030 followed by a decline. This trend directly threatens long-term demand for oil maritime transport and freight rates.
risks.score_rationale: Major structural risk extensively discussed with alarmist language ("material adverse effect", "accelerating"). IEA forecasts 50% electric vehicle sales by 2035 and an oil peak around 2030. Trend clearly upward (up). Existential weight for oil-related operations.

risks.title: Overcapacity in oil transportation
risks.summary: The order book for new oil tankers reached 14.1% in November 2025 (highest in 9 years). If new vessel deliveries exceed scrapping, transport capacity will increase, reducing freight rates and the value of existing vessels. This could render fleet operations unprofitable.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly developed industry risk with precise data (order book at 14.1% in Nov 2025, highest in 9 years). Moderately alerting but clear language ("could materially decline"). Trend upward (up) with direct impact on rates. Categorically high weight.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and sanctions affecting oil shipping routes
risks.summary: Geopolitical conflicts (Ukraine war, Russian sanctions, Iran-Israel tensions, Houthi attacks in the Red Sea, Venezuela instability) create increased freight rate volatility and disrupt trade routes. Ship seizures linked to Venezuela and trade restrictions reduce chartering opportunities and increase operational risks.
risks.score_rationale: Major industry risk with multiple concrete examples (Ukraine war, Russian sanctions, Middle East tensions, Houthi crisis in Red Sea, Venezuela). Intensive language ("great uncertainty", "material adverse effect"). Trend upward (up) with documented current impacts. Categorically high weight.

risks.title: Dependence on a limited number of charterer customers
risks.summary: Okeanis Eco Tankers relies on a limited number of charterers for a significant portion of its revenues. Default or contract termination by these major customers could significantly reduce revenues and operational profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Specific business risk listed in summary ("dependence on a limited number of customers"). Moderately clear language. No quantitative details provided in the excerpt. Trend stable. Categorically medium weight for a shipping company.

risks.title: Dependence on technical manager Kyklades Maritime
risks.summary: Technical fleet management is fully outsourced to Kyklades Maritime Corporation (KMC), an entity linked to the Chairman. Any KMC failure in maintenance, regulatory compliance, or operational optimization could affect vessel performance and revenues.
risks.score_rationale: Specific business risk mentioned in summary ("dependence on KMC") and in potential conflicts of interest. Kyklades is an entity linked to the Chairman. Moderately clear language. Trend stable. Categorically medium weight for shipping structure.

risks.title: Increasing environmental and safety regulatory compliance
risks.summary: Environmental regulations are tightening (ballast water management, low-sulfur fuels, CO2 reductions). These requirements increase operating costs and may render older vessels obsolete, forcing investments in fleet modernization or replacement.
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory risk mentioned in summary ("environmental and safety laws") and developed in supply factors (ballast water, low sulfur fuel, CO2 reductions). Moderately clear language. Trend upward (up) with new standards. Categorically medium weight.

risks.title: Fleet aging and replacement costs
risks.summary: The aging of Okeanis Eco Tankers' fleet increases maintenance costs, risks of unavailability, and regulatory compliance expenses. Replacing older vessels with newbuilds requires significant capital investment and depends on financing availability.
risks.score_rationale: Specific business risk listed ("aging of our fleet and vessel replacement"). Moderately clear language. Trend stable but structural. Categorically medium weight for a shipping company with a mature fleet. Linked to rising operating costs.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents. The company does not appear to integrate AI into its operations or stated strategy.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation
Cited innovations relate to hull coatings and shaft generators, not digital technologies
Cybersecurity programs are based on training, not AI

events.title: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. (ECO) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
events.body: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. (ECO) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +33.91% and +26.67%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
